players: Dương Quốc Hoàng (Hoàng Sao) vs Pijus Labutis

shots.description: Power break from the left side of the box; 8-Ball drops on the break and 1-Yellow sits clean in the upper half.
shots.coach_tip: 💥 Power Break Dynamics: Struck at 28.4 km/h with 1/2 tip below center. The squatting cue ball popped up and transferred 95% kinetic energy, sinking the 8-ball and parking clean in the head string.

shots.description: Hoàng Sao cuts the 1-Yellow cleanly into the Top-Right corner pocket and holds the Cue Ball near center table.
shots.coach_tip: 🎯 Position Control: Center-ball stun stroke with Gear 2 speed holds the cue ball near the table center for prime angle onto 2-Blue.

shots.description: Tactical push/safety off 2-Blue, sending 2-Blue up-table and freezing the Cue Ball near 4-Pink on the bottom rail.
shots.coach_tip: 🛡️ Tactical Push: Controlled half-ball kiss off 2-Blue with low-left spin sends 2-Blue up-table while hiding the cue ball behind 4-Pink.

shots.description: Labutis plays a two-rail kick/safety onto 2-Blue, sending 2-Blue to the bottom-right and freezing the Cue Ball on the head rail.
shots.coach_tip: 🛡️ Two-Rail Escape: Accurate geometric kick off two cushions with slight running english. Left 2-Blue pinned near the bottom-right cushion.

shots.description: Hoàng Sao banks 2-Blue up beside the Top-Right pocket jaw while leaving the Cue Ball mid-table.
shots.coach_tip: 🛡️ Jaw Freeze: Banked 2-Blue into the TR pocket jaw with Gear 2 touch, leaving the cue ball stranded in center table.

shots.description: Hoàng Sao elevates and pots 2-Blue into the Top-Right corner pocket, moving 3-Red to the right rail.
shots.coach_tip: ⭐ Elevated Cue Rail Cut: Elevated butt 30° to clear the rail cushion. Applied 1/2 tip high follow with Gear 3 stroke to pot the ball and float cue ball away from the rail.

shots.description: Labutis kicks off the head cushion to contact 3-Red, but leaves 3-Red visible down the length of the table.
shots.coach_tip: ⚠️ Kick Departure: Contacted 3-Red off the head cushion but failed to tie it to the rail. Left 3-Red open for Hoàng Sao.

shots.description: Hoàng Sao fires 3-Red into the Top-Right corner pocket and floats the Cue Ball to the center for 4-Pink.
shots.coach_tip: 🎯 Center Table Float: Crisp stun-follow stroke into TR pocket, floating cue ball into the center circle for textbook shape on 4-Pink.

shots.description: Starts the final clearance: pots 4-Pink in the Bottom-Left pocket and goes two cushions up the right side for 5-Purple.
shots.coach_tip: ⭐ Two-Cushion Shape Route: Stun-follow with 1 tip right english into BL corner. Cue ball traveled two cushions up the right rail to unlock 5-Purple.

shots.description: Pots 5-Purple into Top-Right and holds the Cue Ball one cushion to the left half of the table for 6-Green.
shots.coach_tip: 🎯 1-Cushion Hold: Soft touch center-ball stroke holds the cue ball off the left rail for ideal straight-in angle on 6-Green.

shots.description: Pots 6-Green in Top-Right with pure backspin draw, pulling the Cue Ball all the way down-table for 7-Brown.
shots.coach_tip: ⭐ Elite Full-Table Draw: Pure bottom spin (6 o'clock) with 17.4 km/h snap stroke. The cue ball bit the Simonis cloth and drew 4.4 meters back for natural line on 7-Brown.

shots.description: Rolls 7-Brown into Bottom-Right pocket and stops dead in line for the 9-Ball.
shots.coach_tip: 🎯 Natural Roll: Gear 1 soft roll-in with center ball stops dead for effortless straight-in clearance on the championship 9-ball.

shots.description: Pots the 9-Ball into Bottom-Right to complete the table run-out ('dọn bàn') and take a 3–1 lead!
shots.coach_tip: 🏆 Match-Winning Shot: Firm center-ball strike into the bottom-right corner pocket to complete the 6-ball run-out and seal the rack 3–1!
